Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the `temporalAccessor.get(ChronoField.DAY_OF_MONTH)` line, which is attempting to retrieve the day of the month from a temporal accessor that only supports the day of the week. This will result in an `UnsupportedTemporalTypeException` being thrown.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the get() method on a TemporalAccessor object with a ChronoField that is not supported by the object's date or time. In this case, the ChronoField.DAY_OF_WEEK and ChronoField.DAY_OF_MONTH are not supported by the TemporalAccessor object created from LocalDate.now(), which causes an UnsupportedTemporalTypeException to be thrown.
